primaryChecks.text: Now these are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel: Bela the son of Beor; and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
primaryChecks.previousContext: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
primaryChecks.nextContext: Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his place.
